borrow_value.meaning: 0x811 borrow.value for the Vault L1 account (positive borrow amount)

spot_usdc.meaning: spot USDC balance shown on the Vault L1 account

proposed_yield.meaning: yield amount the keeper proposes and settle is asked to accept

real_surplus.meaning: real net surplus available to back yield (net of the borrow leg)

settle_accepts_unbacked.meaning: settle accepts a proposedYield that exceeds real surplus, violating Σ proposedYield ≤ Σ surplus

assumptions: The keeper computes surplus() from on-chain Accountant state before proposing yield.
real_surplus is the report's real net surplus, i.e. backing net of the borrow leg; its numeric definition is not given in the report.
settle is the operation whose acceptance of proposedYield is checked against the Gate 3 distributable cap.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of real surplus or the Gate 3 cap, so the bound is carried symbolically as real_surplus.

limitations: Only the impact_unbacked_yield relation (settle accepting yield above real surplus) is formalized; principal displacement and peg solvency are separate passes.
The auto-borrow trigger is conditional and no concrete X is given; borrow_value is symbolic.
